create_ExLink_instance: create an ExLink instance by passing a link object to the constructor
setParent_method: set the parent ExLink of an ExLink instance using the setParent method
addChild_method: add a child ExLink to an ExLink instance using the addChild method
setJoint_method: set the joint on an ExLink instance using the setJoint method
repr_ExLink: get a string representation of an ExLink showing its link, parent, children, and joint
